cim: Guterres: Every Country Must Have the Capacity to Safely Manage Artificial Intelligence
cim_eredeti: Guterres: Every Country Must Have the Capacity to Safely Manage Artificial Intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
António Guterres, the United Nations Secretary-General, has stressed that all countries must have the capacity to safely manage artificial intelligence (AI) and play a role in shaping the future of the technology.

Guterres wrote in a post on X on Tuesday, November 24, that the future of AI should not be determined by a small group of countries on behalf of the rest of the world.

Referring to the lack of tools, knowledge and capacity in many countries to assess AI systems, manage their risks and protect their populations, he said this gap must be addressed.

Guterres also said that all countries should have a role in shaping the future of AI and participate in decisions concerning the technology.
